node.title: Re: utf8 for require scripts (updated)
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Which of the four instances of utf8 in your sample are you referring to? And could you show some example code that reproduces the problem? [id://1177642]

Update: Thank you for adding some sample code, but see [id://17557] - please mark your edits as such. Also, did you mean один or один? On PerlMonks, if you meant the latter, unfortunately it's required to use 

 instead of  tags, which means that HTML/PM special characters like <, >, &, [, and ] need to be escaped too (respectively, <, >, &, [, and ]).
